messages:
Talia (CS): Quick alert  multiple new-onboard customers are reporting embeddings not returning in search and occasional 5xx when creating embeddings between 2026-03-22T14:05Z and 14:22Z. Need a short customer-safe status, a make-good offer, and a plan to collect failing payloads. @Owen can you share triage?
Owen (Eng): Short triage: a deployed change to the batch-header normalization caused a subset of chunk IDs to be written with an incompatible prefix; downstream validators dropped those writes which led to retries and elevated error rates. We've disabled the offending normalization, paused the affected batcher group, and started targeted replays. Backfill progress ~40%.
Pri (SRE): Cluster stabilized after isolating the batcher pool and reducing retry aggressiveness. No indication of data exfiltration. Live monitor: https://internal.ops/redwood/inc/4725. Expected catch-up window 2-4h depending on peak. Incident ID INC-4725.
Nate (AM): I'll draft the outreach to impacted trials and renewal-risk accounts. Proposed customer language (concise): 'We're mitigating an ingestion issue affecting a small set of accounts. Engineering has identified the cause and activated replays; we expect restoration within a few hours. No customer data exposure. We're offering a make-good: waived overage charges for this billing cycle plus a 45-minute technical clinic. We'll follow up with an RCA within 48 hours.' Any edits? :memo:
Talia (CS): That reads well. Please also request customers to share failing job IDs or a copy of the payload (redact secrets) so we can validate replays. Offer a simple self-check after we confirm recovery: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"healthcheck"}' | jq '.status, .embedding | length'
# expect: "ok" and a numeric length > 0
```
Owen (Eng): Add a short note for engineers: if customers provide job ids include header X-Orig-Job: <id> when re-running replays so we can map artifacts. Also logging snippet: ```WARN batcher: dropped chunk header mismatch uid=sh-34 prefix="v1-old"```
CommsBot: Outbound comm queued to 14 impacted tenants. Office hours scheduled: Thu 16:00 UTC and Fri 09:00 UTC. Backfill jobs: bf-4725-a progress=40% ETA=03:20:00
Talia (CS): Action items: 1) Nate send the outbound comm + credits/clinic offer and invite to office hours 2) CS open feedback tracker and paste payloads/job ids https://docs.internal/cs/inc-4725-feedback 3) Eng/SRE finalize RCA draft and publish within 48h 4) Flag any accounts with renewals in next 90 days for priority AM follow-up. I'll monitor replies and escalate.
